title: Shared definitions
description: Draft 0.2. Below protocol 1.0 there is no compatibility promise. Top-level objects of a manifest and a record accept extra fields under an x- prefix; nested objects are closed.

identity.description: Algorithm name, a colon, the lowercase hexadecimal digest. The algorithm fixes the length. sha256 is the only algorithm in this draft.

name.description: Stable name of a node: survives edits to content.

emulated_on.description: Present when the run executed under emulation on a different architecture.

verdict.description: Outcome of one run (decision 0005). Only passed and failed are reusable.

status.description: Derived by the kernel for an obligation. Never supplied by a provider.

relpath.description: First filter only. The normative path check (NFC, reserved names, trailing dot or space, case-fold collisions, . and .. segments) is a function published with test vectors, not a pattern.

class.description: Provider-named evidence class or conformance method, for example proof, bounded-model-check, test, trace-replay.

rank.description: Kernel-owned ordering used by policy: all inputs; all inputs within stated bounds; some inputs; no check, only a written mapping.
